items.name: 기름통 (10L)
items.visual_description: Worn red plastic jerry can, black cap and handle. Scratches, dirt smudges, faded fuel warning label. Spout folded against the side, slight dent on lower half. Dark red with lighter red highlights.

items.name: 타이어 응급패치킷
items.visual_description: Small open olive-green plastic case containing black rubber patches, a tiny tube of vulcanizing glue, and a metal rasp tool. Tire icon embossed on the lid. Compact, utilitarian.

items.name: 담배
items.visual_description: Crumpled soft-pack cigarette box, slightly crushed, one cigarette poking out. Faded white pack with thin red stripe. Half-empty, well-used. Muted warm tones.

items.name: 파츠 직드롭
items.visual_description: Shiny metallic gear or mechanical component with faint golden-yellow glow aura. Silver/chrome colored with visible teeth or connectors. Subtle sparkle effect to indicate rarity.

items.name: 고철 덩어리
items.visual_description: Irregular chunk of rusted metal with jagged edges. Dark brown rust and dull grey steel mixed. Bent nails and twisted sheet metal fused together. Rough, worthless-looking debris.

items.name: 알루미늄 캔 묶음
items.visual_description: Three crushed aluminum soda cans tied with thin string. Dented, flattened, faded colorful labels (red, blue, green). Silver aluminum showing where labels peeled off.

items.name: 동선 묶음
items.visual_description: Coiled bundle of stripped copper wire, bright orange-brown with metallic sheen. Loosely wound into a donut shape, some strands sticking out. Warm distinctive copper color.

items.name: 와이퍼 블레이드
items.visual_description: Single windshield wiper blade, horizontal. Thin black rubber edge on silver metal frame arm. Rubber slightly worn and cracked at edges. Simple elongated shape.

items.name: 오일 필터
items.visual_description: Cylindrical car oil filter. Dark blue or black metal canister, rubber gasket ring on top. Greasy, stained with old oil residue. Wrench-grip texture on surface.

items.name: 스파크 플러그 세트
items.visual_description: Three spark plugs side by side. White ceramic insulator top, hexagonal metal body, threaded electrode tip. Slightly sooty and used. Off-white ceramic, dull steel grey metal.

items.name: 중고 배터리
items.visual_description: Rectangular 12V car battery. Black plastic casing, two lead terminals (red +, black -) on top. White corrosion around terminals, acid stain marks on sides. Faded yellow warning label. Heavy, bulky.

items.name: 사이드미러
items.visual_description: Detached car side mirror with broken mounting stalk. Diagonal crack across mirror glass. Black plastic housing, distorted pale blue-grey reflection. Wires dangling from broken mount.

items.name: 통조림
items.visual_description: Small tin can, paper label mostly torn off showing bare silver metal. Pull-tab ring on top. Remaining label fragment with faded text. Slight dent on side.

items.name: 손전등
items.visual_description: Small handheld flashlight. Black rubberized body, silver reflector head. Lens slightly scratched. Click button on tail end. Compact tactical style, no light beam.

items.name: 상비약 세트
items.visual_description: Small white plastic first aid box with red cross on lid. Slightly scuffed and dirty. Simple metal latch. Bandage strips peeking from under the lid.

items.name: 공구 세트
items.visual_description: Open dark olive-green canvas tool roll with wrench, flathead screwdriver, Phillips screwdriver, pliers in fabric pockets. Canvas worn and oil-stained. Steel grey tools with wooden handles.

items.name: 스마트폰
items.visual_description: Modern smartphone with badly cracked screen. Spider-web crack pattern on dark glass display. Black case, rounded corners. Faint glitchy colored lines through cracks. Dead, unusable.

items.name: 지갑
items.visual_description: Brown leather bifold wallet, slightly open with paper bills (Korean won) sticking out. Worn, creased leather. Darker brown stitching along edges.

items.name: 금반지
items.visual_description: Simple gold wedding band ring. Warm yellow-gold color with subtle metallic shine highlight. Clean and polished, contrasting with the gritty aesthetic of other items. Small, precious.

items.name: 군용 물자
items.visual_description: Military MOLLE utility pouch, olive drab / woodland camo. Buckle closure on top. Thick tactical fabric. Korean military marking stenciled in black. Stuffed and bulging, suggesting valuable contents.
